title: Kestrel Care Vehicle Service Contract Limit of Liability and Claim Payment Schedule
content:
Every Kestrel Care Vehicle Service Contract plan has an aggregate limit of liability whose basis is the vehicle purchase price on the bill of sale, subject to a maximum that differs by plan, regardless of the purchase price.

## Aggregate limit of liability

| Plan | Basis of the aggregate limit | Maximum aggregate limit regardless of purchase price (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Care Powertrain | Vehicle purchase price on the bill of sale | 15000.00 |
| Kestrel Care Gold | Vehicle purchase price on the bill of sale | 25000.00 |
| Kestrel Care Gold Plus | Vehicle purchase price on the bill of sale | 30000.00 |
| Kestrel Care Platinum | Vehicle purchase price on the bill of sale | 40000.00 |
| Kestrel Care Platinum Plus | Vehicle purchase price on the bill of sale | 50000.00 |
| Kestrel Care Platinum Elite | Vehicle purchase price on the bill of sale | 60000.00 |

## Claim payment and filing

| Plan | How covered repairs are paid | Paid within (business days after the repair order closes) | Holder reimbursement claims filed within (calendar days after the repair order closes) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Care Powertrain | Paid to the repair facility by corporate card at authorization close | 5 | 90 |
| Kestrel Care Gold | Paid to the repair facility by corporate card at authorization close | 5 | 90 |
| Kestrel Care Gold Plus | Paid to the repair facility by corporate card at authorization close | 5 | 90 |
| Kestrel Care Platinum | Paid to the repair facility by corporate card at authorization close | 5 | 90 |
| Kestrel Care Platinum Plus | Paid to the repair facility by corporate card at authorization close | 5 | 90 |
| Kestrel Care Platinum Elite | Paid to the repair facility by corporate card at authorization close | 5 | 90 |

## Notes

- The two day counts run on different calendars: payment is counted in business days, a holder's reimbursement filing window in calendar days, and both start when the repair order closes.
- The maximum in the limit table caps the limit; a vehicle purchase price below the maximum is not raised to it.
